title: journal record
description: Journal record envelope with the body schema of its kind (03-api.md section 7.1 GET /v1/journal, section 7.2).

oneOf.description: failure with a reason of enums/session-failure-reasons.json

body_session_output.description: one assistant message from the transcript; text longer than 64 Ki characters is cut and truncated is true

input.description: JSON text of the tool input, cut at 64 Ki characters

result_summary.description: tool result text, cut at 64 Ki characters

rule.description: rule number of 05-runner.md section 5.3 that decided (PreToolUse)

body_session_hook_summary.description: Summary of the routine hook calls of a session (ADR-086 section 3): PreToolUse allow and PostToolUse none without a reason are counted instead of journaled one by one and written at most every 10 s and before any other hook or state record of the session. counts per hook event, tools the PreToolUse calls per tool name (the keys are tool names, pattern ^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,128}$, at most 256; empty when no PreToolUse call with a valid tool name was counted), from/to the journal times of the first and the last counted call.

tools.description: PreToolUse calls per tool name; empty when only PostToolUse calls (or calls without a valid tool name) were counted

body_session_hook_record.description: A session.hook body: one hook call (body_session_hook) or the summary of routine calls (body_session_hook_summary, KOR-35).

oneOf.description: Several changed files in one record (HOT-06): a scan pass over the bulk bound or the part beyond the session's window; path is their common directory (else the first path), paths at most 20 of them, no patches.

body_session_terminal.description: terminal chunk; at most 16384 characters of data per event, the body JSON of a record at most 64 KiB - 16 bytes (checked by the producer; the guest writes at most 60 KiB, KOR-35)

items.description: [t_ms, code, data]: asciicast v2 event (code 'o' output, 'm' marker after a recorder restart)

provider_outside_allowlist.description: present only when the provider is outside the provisioned provider_allowlist (05-runner.md section 10.2); the runner records the audit model.provider_outside_allowlist

params.description: parameters as sent by the session; checked again by the runner against ops/<type>.params.json

local_check.description: result of the guest's schema check of type and params (05-runner.md section 12 step 1); rejected is binding for the runner (it registers the operation with local_check rejected and never executes it), passed is not (the runner repeats the check)

local_error.description: the operation error the guest returned to the session (unknown_type or params_invalid); exactly with local_check rejected

body_platform_query.description: read call of a platform tool, answered by the runner

body_platform_read.description: a session platform read answered by the guest itself (get_notifications, 03-api.md section 8.1): the runner records the platform.read event and the audit read.session.<tool> as for a forwarded read (contracts/changes/KOR-07.md)

body_platform_refused.description: an MCP request of the session refused before it was forwarded or answered (03-api.md section 8: every call is journaled); metadata only, never arguments (contracts/changes/KOR-07.md, KOR-10.md); a protocol-level refusal never names a tool; a refused method is named when it is one of the protocol (else other, contracts/changes/HOT-09.md)

oneOf.description: a method the server does not offer; method names it when it is a request method of the protocol, else other (HOT-09; a guest before HOT-09 sends no method)

body_metrics.description: periodic sample (02-data-model.md section 5 lists the kind; same fields as GET /v1/metrics)

record.description: journal record {seq, ts, session_id, kind, body}; session_id null only for VM-level kinds (metrics, guest.error)

body_workvm_call.description: a call of a work VM tool, answered by the runner (13-work-vm.md section 3)

body_session_tools_ready.description: the session's agent listed the platform tools on /mcp for the first time in this run of the agent (HOT-09): the first prompt is delivered only after it
